statisticsMethod: Unchanged runner: nearest-rank element at floor(n*quantile), capped at n-1; no interpolation or trimming. Archived statistics copied verbatim.
rawDataRetention: Original full captures and companions are in the public CI artifact. This file retains whitelisted metadata, statistics, all direct sample arrays and hashes; it does not rewrite raw captures.
